rewrite.source: WKn React-style hook using y/P/R/Z/TCo render primitives
rewrite.reason: this runtime has no React render loop to host a hook
rewrite.replacement: GitDiffDataController keeps the effect dependency order, one-shot prime take, same-key suppression, 150ms debounce, abort of the previous collection, same-revision hunk fallback and derived view; onChange is the host notification

rewrite.source: K through uxn, whose session and branch-point sources need host snapshot and repository services this runtime does not carry
rewrite.reason: no session snapshot or branch-point provider in the host
rewrite.replacement: collectGitDiff always reads the working-tree stats from W161 and hunks from W162; baseMode is accepted and recorded but does not change the source; source log calls have no host counterpart, so failures collapse to null as the source catch does

notes: The prime store is the verbatim source class; TTL expires only when now-at > 2000, and a baseMode mismatch leaves the entry intact.
A null prime entry still counts as loaded for its refresh key, matching the source WKn initialization.
Files sort by path; the large-file flag comes from skippedLarge; truncation applies only to non-large, non-binary files over 400 changed lines.
The diff dialog, navigation, uxn source selection and session/branch-point sources remain out.
